correctness.rationale: Explicit bijective formula for palindromes with the maximal 2k+1 runs; the remaining odd-run palindromes satisfy a q-ary composition upper bound O(n^k). AM–GM proves a uniform sharp n^(k+1) upper bound and a two-letter alternating construction attains it. Uniqueness of the AM–GM equality case and an exact slack identity prove necessity and sufficiency of the normalized near-maximizer shape. Standalone enumerator verified 54,007 bounded cases.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp polynomial degree, alphabet-independent leading constant and asymptotically necessary and sufficient run geometry for a natural constrained version of the distinct scattered-palindrome counting problem. This structural characterization separates palindrome symmetry constraints from all-subsequence run-extremal counts, and is nontrivial even though it is not an exact finite-length optimization for general k.
